\begin{minipage}{\linewidth}\scriptsize\raggedright
\textit{Population:} BASE paired with FINAL[v] (cells in both paired cohorts). \textit{Unit:} base cell.
Block: composite; cell = base cells with this Q06 (row) and E02 (column) transition; Q06 not\_pass-\textgreater{}pass with E02 not\_all\_pass-\textgreater{}not\_all\_pass = repaired on ParEval, not on the held-out specs; the cohort lies within both R04 paired cohorts and the row / column sums within the R01 Q06 / E02 transition counts (checked).
POST-FREEZE (study\_analysis\_001.addendum\_1, DECLARED\_AFTER\_DRY\_RUN, declared 2026-10-17; descriptive, not part of the frozen methodology): X06 joint\_parEval\_heldout\_transitions - post-freeze descriptive; E02 counts build failures, so E02 and Q06 changes are largely the same cells.
BL01: Includes dense\_la/00 (BL-01 tolerance convention: possible false FAIL verdicts; disclosure-bearing aggregate); sensitivity SA1 in T10.
IC1: Q06 is in-sample for test\_feedback and combined\_feedback: their loops see the ParEval test verdict and stop when it passes (every stopped\_tests\_pass trajectory is a Q06 pass), so they optimise the endpoint; for static\_feedback Q06 is out-of-sample (measured once in phase 2, never seen by the loop). The variants therefore differ in trigger and stop rules, not only in feedback content; test\_feedback cannot regress on Q06 by construction.
IC2: E02 is not an independent confirmation of Q06 gains: it counts build failures, and most E02 improvements are the same cells as the Q06 improvements; the held-out signal proper is the joint transition X06 (e.g. Q06 repaired but E02 still failing) and G01.
IC6: static\_feedback repair triggers are dominated by clang-tidy bugprone findings and, on MPI, by low-confidence hints (design document: no trustworthy static MPI tool exists); static\_feedback results measure this frozen blocking-set configuration, not static analysis in general.
\textit{Definitions} (methodology and addendum; full text in the JSON form of this table): BASE; FINAL; X06 joint\_parEval\_heldout\_transitions; R01 repair\_transition.\par
\end{minipage}
